title: Spiritual Crystal - Infusion
text: In a modifier slot, a spiritual crystal writes Infusion and counts toward component cost. This is separate from its use as the substrate.

Undelayed Harm becomes Instant Damage II, including vanilla's reversed effect on undead. Instant healing gains brief Saturation; Regeneration gains Resistance of matching level and duration. Infusion does not change Poison into another effect.
For dissociation, it increases produce and equipment limits per round, and raises Fortune for blocks. For construction, it makes void crystal permanent and allows locked creatures to be mined.
